subject: DAILY SYNC STOP-WORK: freeze new work/spawns for Artifactory capacity calibration
body: Primary daily synchronization barrier. All active, stalled, pending-prompt, Manager/Reviewer and Research sessions must stop starting new work, preserve current state, publish any material handoff already in flight, and do not claim new spawn tickets until a RESUME/CAPACITY directive is durable. Existing irreversible external actions must fail safe rather than be abandoned mid-transaction. This is a synchronization/calibration barrier, not cancellation of the round.

daily_sync.purpose: single daily Artifactory write-capacity calibration before resuming/scaling
